title: Zesty Lemon Posset
summary: A bright, zesty lemon posset with the zest steeped in the cream, topped with fresh lemon strips.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Infuse and reduce
steps.text: combine the cream, sugar, grated zest and salt in the pan, bring to the boil and boil 3-5 min, stirring, until slightly reduced. Zest gives off its fragrant oils in the hot cream.

steps.title: Add the juice
steps.text: off the heat, whisk in the lemon juice.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: wait 15 min, then strain into the jug to remove the zest for a smooth set. Removing the zest leaves a perfectly smooth set.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: pour into the bowls and chill at least 3 h, uncovered at first.

steps.title: Decorate
steps.text: top each with a few fine strips of lemon zest and serve with a lemon slice on the side. Fresh zest on top adds a fresh lemon scent.

tips: A common mistake is grating the white pith with the zest; it makes the posset bitter.
Zest the lemons before you juice them.
Chill overnight for the firmest set.
storage: Cover once set and keep in the fridge for up to 2 days. Add the zest strips just before serving.
